rules.rule: Opening the reagent map shows every reagent site at its position on the planet.

examples.text: The shop publishes 8 sites; the map shows 8 markers, each at its site's latitude and longitude.
A site at 180 degrees longitude and one near the north pole are shown where they are, not clipped or wrapped.
A site the shop has not published is not shown.

rules.rule: Opening the map shows the shop's seeded expeditions, and a signed-in adventurer's own saved expeditions, each where it was drawn.

examples.text: Signed out: the 3 seeded lines are shown and nothing else.
Signed in as Elara, who saved one line: the 3 seeded lines and Elara's line are shown.
Signed in as Elara: a line saved by Borin is not shown.
A seeded line is not drawn more than the agreed tolerance away from its seeded endpoints.

rules.rule: Flying to a reagent site brings it on screen, on the near side of the globe.

examples.text: With the camera over the opposite side of the planet, choosing 'Moonwell Spring' turns the globe until the site is on screen and facing the camera.
Before choosing a site, a site on the far side is not on screen.

rules.rule: A line is drawn by placing two points on the land; it follows the agreed kind of line between them.

examples.text: After choosing the line tool, clicking near Moonwell Spring and then near Ember Crag shows a line between those two places.
Two points far apart give a line that follows the agreed path between them (geodesic or rhumb, Q4).
After only one click, no line is complete and Save is not offered.

rules.rule: A click that is not on the land of the near side places nothing.

examples.text: With the line tool waiting, a click on a point on the land is placed.
A click on space beside the globe places nothing, and the tool still waits for a point.
A click on the limb of the globe, where the far side would be, places nothing.

rules.rule: A signed-in adventurer can save a completed line, and sees it again after reopening the map, within the agreed tolerance.

examples.text: Elara draws a line from Moonwell Spring to Ember Crag, saves it, reloads, and the line is shown with both ends within tolerance of where she placed them.
An endpoint saved 5 km from where it was placed counts as wrong.

rules.rule: Saving is refused when the adventurer is signed out or the line has zero length; nothing is stored.

examples.text: Signed in, a line between two different places is saved.
Signed out, pressing Save asks the adventurer to sign in, and after signing in and reopening the map the line is not there.
Both points placed at the same place: Save is refused and nothing is stored.

rules.rule: An unsaved line can be abandoned; nothing is stored.

examples.text: Elara places one point, chooses the line tool again, and starts over from no points.
Elara draws a line and leaves the map without saving; reopening it shows no new line.

questions.question: How close must a saved or seeded endpoint be to where it was placed, in km on the planet?
Is a line the shortest path over the surface (geodesic) or straight on a flat map (rhumb)?
After a click off the land, does the adventurer see anything (a message, a shake), or does nothing happen?
questions.assumption: Nothing happens; the tool keeps waiting.

questions.question: Can an adventurer see other adventurers' expeditions?
Which expeditions are seeded, and who owns them?
questions.assumption: 3 shop-owned lines crossing named sites, one reaching the far side from the default camera.

questions.question: Planet name, radius, and the reagent sites.
questions.assumption: Planet 'Aurelis', radius 6,000 km, 8 named sites including one near each pole and one at 180 degrees longitude.

questions.question: Wave 2: does a site on a circle's edge count as enclosed, and do overlapping circles count a site once or twice?
New: when two points are 'the same place', is that exactly equal, or closer than the tolerance?
